text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Cheval Grand—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Cheval Grand is pointing, I 
see a crane game filled with plushies 
modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: A new one came out, huh... ............

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: ぬいぐるみ、欲しいのか？

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
L-Let's get going, Trainer. If someone 
wants to play, we'll just be in the way...
choice_data_list:
...Well then, maybe I'll hang out and play 
here!

...Well then, maybe I'll hang out and play 
here!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: ……じゃあ俺、ここで遊んでいこうかな！
……じゃあ私、ここで遊んでいこうかな！
choice_data_list_en: ……Then maybe I'll hang out and play here for a bit!
...Well then, maybe I'll hang out here and play for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
F-Fishing practice...? Come to think of 
it... it might be a little similar.
choice_data_list: 釣りの練習になるかなって！
choice_data_list_en: I figured it'd make for good fishing practice!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Understood, I'll be cheering for you... 
Good luck, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
